newsitem.title: UK: BOE sets six pct rate on UK money market repos.
newsitem.headline: BOE sets six pct rate on UK money market repos.

text.p: The Bank of England said on Wednesday it set a rate of six percent on repos and secured loan facilities starting on Thursday.
The rate is the same as that currently applying to the Bank's day-to-day money market repos.
The two-week repo will mature on March 20, 21 and 24 while the five-week option matures on April 10, 11 and 14.
The two- and five-week repos represent the Bank's regular, twice-monthly repo offerings.

The Bank said the premium rate set will in future normally be the stated repo rate currently applied by the Bank in the course of its daily open market operations for repos of approximately two weeks.

This replaces the previous arrangements when the premium rate was normally the yield equivalent of the lowest rate of discount at which the Bank bought bills with a remaining maturity of five-to-33 days in its daily operations, the Bank said.
